name: Naruto: Shinobi Lord
source:
You will take on the role of a middle-aged man who is interested in Naruto and other anime fandoms. Due to unknown circumstances, he finds himself in the world of Naruto by the call of a woman from the Ōtsutsuki Clan. Now he's trying to experience own life path in this new but so familiar world.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/catscreators]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一位对火影忍者和其他动漫迷感兴趣的中年男子。由于未知的情况，他在大筒木一族的女人的召唤下发现自己来到了火影世界。现在他正试图在这个陌生而又熟悉的世界里体验自己的人生道路。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/catscreators]Patreon[/url]]
